text:
vivian: Running a short consolidation across Q1/Q2 PMRs. A few recurring remediation issues: (a) ownership drift after handoff, (b) insufficient guardrails for model fallback, (c) probe jitter too low. Posting proposed handoff steps and owners.

omar: Can you paste the selection query you used? want to validate coverage.

vivian: Sure: ```sql
SELECT pmr_id, root_cause, owner, last_update
FROM pmr_actions
WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-04-01'
AND status != 'done'
AND root_cause ilike '%fallback%' OR root_cause ilike '%probe%';
```

li: Looks good. I counted 12 actions with owner null and 9 with owner stale (>45d).

carlos: On fallback guardrails, we keep seeing model switchovers when a single probe series spikes. A soft-fallback policy could reduce churn.

sasha: Agree. propose: soft-fallback threshold = 3 consecutive degraded probes OR p95_latency > 800ms for 30s, then reduce concurrency by 25% before switching model. owner: sasha + li. ETA: 2026-05-05.

omar: For ownership drift, propose sweep automation: weekly job that lists actions where owner is null OR last_update < now() - interval '30 days'. It posts to the original channel and pings the oncall. owner: omar. ETA: 2026-04-04.

ops-bot: Auto-note: last sweep ran 2026-02-20. 16 items flagged; 10 reassigned.

vivian: Additional tactical: add a mandatory "handoff checklist" field in PMR close workflow with owner and secondary. If secondary not set, the sweep tags it and escalates. owner: vivian. ETA: 2026-04-12.

li: I'll take the probe-jitter change and canary rules. change: set jitter 30-200ms and add readiness_grace 8s. owner: li. ETA: 2026-04-07.

carlos: I'll draft the soft-fallback implementation details and a rollback plan. will include metrics to measure: fallback_count, model_switch_rate, and p99 latency.

sasha: For success metrics: target 60% reduction in model switch events within 30 days of rollout for affected clusters.

omar: Sweep automation note: please ensure sweep excludes items with tag 'blocked:design' or 'awaiting-customer'.

vivian: Action recap (react with :thumbsup: to accept):
- omar: sweep automation + slack notifier (ETA 2026-04-04)
- vivian: handoff checklist field + updater on PMR close (ETA 2026-04-12)
- li: probe jitter + readiness canary (ETA 2026-04-07)
- sasha + li: soft-fallback policy design + canary (ETA 2026-05-05)
- carlos: implementation plan + metrics (ETA 2026-04-20)

omar: +1 :thumbsup: will add a small digest to oncall rotation.

li: +1 will open PR and schedule canary.

carlos: +1 will attach metrics dashboards.

sasha: +1 pairing with li on API surface.

ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync on 2026-04-14 09:30 PT.

vivian: I'll update the patterns tracker and include the SQL used plus a column 'handoff_secondary' so secondaries are explicit.

omar: Can we also add an SLA: owner assigned within 5 business days of sweep or escalate?

vivian: Yes, adding SLA: 5 business days then manager digest.

li: Quick note: for the jitter change, we'll monitor p95 and p99 for 48h post-canary. if p99 increases >5% we'll rollback.

carlos: For metrics, i'll add a short query to compute model_switch_rate per cluster and link it.

sasha: tagging this thread as input for the monthly recurring-patterns report.

vivian: Thanks everyone. Please link PRs/tickets in the tracker row so I can include remediation coverage in the report.

ops-bot: Thread archived to incident-patterns index.
